mapper.select: SELECT SEQNO AS msgid, BIZTYPE AS messagetype, MSG AS msg, CALLPHONE AS phn, REQPHONE AS smssender, REQTIME AS reservedt, SUBJECT AS title, YELLOWID_KEY AS profile, TEMPLATECODE AS tmplid FROM ${msg_table} WHERE RESULT = '0' AND BIZTYPE = #{msg_type} AND ( REQTIME IS NULL OR REQTIME = '00000000000000' OR REQTIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${log_table} SELECT * FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SEQNO = #{msgid}
